caveats.flight call: crow-tools has no flight-call flag, so all 40 positives come from the archive set. Uniform 1024-d window-mean pooling removes the single-window std=0 shortcut (experiments 0036, 0121), though recording acoustics still differ across corpora (within-archive grouped AUC is ~0.74 vs ~0.86 combined).
caveats.rattle: crow-tools' `call` class came exclusively from its `rattle` flag (experiment 0012) and is emitted honestly as `rattle`. Weak archive generic `call` tags are excluded from fitting `rattle` (experiment 0121); ordinary contact caws remain unlabelled in crow-tools.
caveats.co-occurrence: A one-vs-rest head's probabilities are independent and do not sum to one. Do not argmax them and call the result a confidence.
